Name: Disk Health Deck
Description: Disk dashboard for your desk: free space, SMART health, I/O activity, temperatures, plus network, fans and power. Threshold alerts flash the key when a disk runs low, overheats or wears out. Sensors require LibreHardwareMonitor (web server enabled) or HWiNFO.

com.diskdeck.monitor.usage.Name: Disk Space
com.diskdeck.monitor.usage.Tooltip: Free space of a drive, as a ring or a bar.

com.diskdeck.monitor.activity.Name: Disk Activity
com.diskdeck.monitor.activity.Tooltip: Live read and write throughput, as lines or a histogram.

com.diskdeck.monitor.overview.Name: Disk Overview
com.diskdeck.monitor.overview.Tooltip: Compact bars with the usage of every drive.

com.diskdeck.monitor.temp.Name: Disk Temperature
com.diskdeck.monitor.temp.Tooltip: Drive temperature with a colour-coded scale.

com.diskdeck.monitor.power.Name: Power
com.diskdeck.monitor.power.Tooltip: Power draw of a CPU, GPU or other component, with history.

com.diskdeck.monitor.back.Name: Back
com.diskdeck.monitor.back.Tooltip: Return to the previous profile. Meant for the plugin disk view.

com.diskdeck.monitor.health.Name: Disk Health
com.diskdeck.monitor.health.Tooltip: Remaining life, power-on hours and start count (SMART).

com.diskdeck.monitor.network.Name: Network
com.diskdeck.monitor.network.Tooltip: Live download and upload of a network interface.

com.diskdeck.monitor.fan.Name: Fan
com.diskdeck.monitor.fan.Tooltip: Fan speed in RPM, with history.
